results.title: US Senate leaves nation’s capital in advance of midterms with much still undone
results.description: U.S. senators departed Capitol Hill on Wednesday night for their campaign break, leaving numerous policy disputes unresolved.

results.title: Former Lt. Gov. Dale Caldwell suspended as Plainfield pastor
results.description: Days after resigning as New Jersey's lieutenant governor amid findings that he sexually harassed a subordinate, Dale Caldwell has been suspended as pastor of Covenant United Methodist Church in Plainfield while a new complaint is investigated.

results.title: EU rejects Trump’s diesel export ban as 'not beneficial to anyone'
results.description: The EU had sharp words for the Trump administration after it threatened to impose a diesel export ban if Europe does not release emergency stocks.

results.title: Sweden’s SDP Leader Andersson Again Tasked with Forming Government
results.description: A vote on a new prime minister will be held in parliament after the exploratory process is completed. On Friday, Swedish Parliament Speaker Andreas Norlen again tasked Social Democratic Party (SDP) leader and former Prime Minister Magdalena Andersson with exploring the prospects of forming a new government. results.title: ARA celebrates a new Enfoquem to identify who has the command of the future
results.description: In a few years, the international order has become more unstable and multifaceted. Not only have the poles of power multiplied, but technology has also ceased to be fundamentally a vehicle for innovation and progress to become, in addition, a fundamental actor, crucial for understanding what war or communication is like in the 21st century, if they are even two different things. To map out this new landscape, ARA is organizing a new edition of Enfoquem : the Solutions Forum, aimed at pointing out viable paths for the future based on a firm but calm assessment of current problems and offering readers and subscribers keys to decode the current moment.
